entity_title: Residents must carry the migratory ID (DIMEX)
fact_text: Every foreign resident in Costa Rica must carry, keep and present on request the document that proves their migratory status - in practice the DIMEX (Documento de Identidad Migratorio para Extranjeros) issued by Migracion. Once resident, a passport alone does not suffice: the DIMEX is the working ID for banking, payroll and any control check.
evidence_quote: Las personas extranjeras que se encuentren en territorio nacional tendrán la obligación de portar, conservar y presentar, a solicitud de la autoridad competente, la documentación que acredite su identidad

applies_to.non_obvious_note: HR often assumes a passport is enough; Costa Rican law makes carrying the migratory ID (the DIMEX) a standing legal duty for every resident (Art. 33(2)).

entity_title: Corporate hires use an employer-tied temporary residence
fact_text: A corporate transferee relocates under temporary residence, specifically the subcategory for executives, representatives, managers and technical staff of companies established in Costa Rica, plus specialized employees required for the work. This is the employer-tied route, separate from the passive rentista, inversionista and pensionado categories.
evidence_quote: Los ejecutivos, los representantes, los gerentes y el personal técnico de las empresas establecidas en el país, así como sus cónyuges e hijos.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: The employer-sponsored route is a specific temporary-residence subcategory (Art. 79(3)) and depends on the company being established in Costa Rica - not the widely marketed rentista/pensionado paths.

entity_title: Temporary residence is capped at two years, renewable
fact_text: Temporary residence is granted for a defined term of more than 90 days and up to two years, renewable for equal periods. Assignment length and renewal timing should be planned around this two-year ceiling rather than assuming an open-ended permit.
evidence_quote: La Dirección General de Migración otorgará una autorización de ingreso y permanencia por un tiempo definido, superior a noventa días y hasta por dos años, prorrogable en igual tanto

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Each temporary-residence grant is capped at two years (renewable), not open-ended, so renewals must be diarised well ahead of expiry.

entity_title: Permanent residence needs 3 consecutive years first
fact_text: Permanent residence generally only becomes available after holding temporary residence for three consecutive years (it is also open to first-degree relatives of a Costa Rican citizen). A newly arrived corporate transferee is a temporary resident for at least three years before permanent status is even an option.
evidence_quote: Podrán optar por la categoría migratoria de residente permanente, las personas extranjeras que cumplan los siguientes requisitos: 1) La persona extranjera, su cónyuge y sus familiares de primer grado por consanguinidad que hayan gozado de una residencia temporal durante tres años consecutivos.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: A mandatory three-consecutive-year temporary-residence period precedes permanent residence - material for long assignments and family planning.

entity_title: Intra-company transfer is a distinct special category
fact_text: Costa Rican migration law recognizes intra-company transfer (personal de transferencia dentro de una misma empresa) as a distinct special migratory category, alongside specific-occupation workers and business visitors. HR should confirm with Migracion which track - ordinary temporary residence or this special category - fits a given transfer.
evidence_quote: Trabajadores de ocupación específica, visitantes de negocios, personal de transferencia dentro de una misma empresa y personal adscrito a los servicios posteriores a la venta, así como trabajadores por cuenta propia.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: An ICT-style special category (Art. 94) exists separately from ordinary temporary residence; choosing the wrong track can delay or invalidate the filing.

entity_title: Work rights are limited to the activity Migracion authorizes
fact_text: A temporary resident may only carry out the remunerated or profit-making activities that Migracion expressly authorizes, taking into account a (non-binding) recommendation from the Ministry of Labour. Work authorization attaches to the approved job and employer, so changing employer or role requires fresh authorization.
evidence_quote: Los residentes temporales únicamente podrán realizar las actividades remuneradas o lucrativas, por cuenta propia o en relación de dependencia, que la Dirección General les autorice.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Residency is not a general right to work: the permit authorizes only the specific activity/employer approved (Art. 80), so role or employer changes need re-authorization.

entity_title: Employer must verify legal stay before hiring
fact_text: Before hiring or giving work to any foreigner, the employer, intermediary or contractor must verify the person's legal stay and that they are authorized to work, and must require the document evidencing their migratory status. The verification duty sits on the employer, not only on the worker.
evidence_quote: Todo empleador, intermediario o contratista, al contratar o proporcionar trabajo u ocupación a una persona extranjera, deberá verificar la permanencia legal en el país de la persona extranjera y que se encuentre autorizada para ello

applies_to.non_obvious_note: The statutory duty to check legal stay and work authorization falls on the employer/contractor (Art. 176) - an onboarding checkpoint, not just the employee's responsibility.

entity_title: Employing an unauthorized foreigner is fined 2-12 salarios base
fact_text: An employer that gives work to a foreigner who is not authorized, or who performs activities other than those authorized, faces a Migracion fine of between two and twelve times a 'salario base'. Premature start dates or unapproved role changes are therefore a direct financial risk to the company.
evidence_quote: Las personas físicas o los representantes de las personas jurídicas, públicas o privadas, que proporcionen trabajo u ocupación a personas extranjeras no habilitadas, para que ejerzan actividades laborales en el país o realicen actividades diferentes de las autorizadas, serán sancionadas por la Dirección General con una multa que oscilará entre dos y hasta doce veces el monto de un salario base

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Letting someone start before authorization, or in a different role than approved, exposes the company to a fine of 2-12 salarios base (Art. 177).

entity_title: Territorial tax: foreign-source income generally untaxed
fact_text: Costa Rica taxes on a territorial basis: income tax reaches only income, revenue or benefits of Costa Rican source, i.e. generated within national territory. A resident's foreign-source income is generally outside the ordinary tax base, with narrow exceptions for certain passive income of multinational groups.
evidence_quote: se entenderá por rentas, ingresos, o beneficios de fuente costarricense los generados exclusivamente en el territorio nacional

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Unlike worldwide-tax systems, Costa Rica generally does not tax a resident's foreign-source income (Ley 7092, Art. 1) - a material, non-obvious point for transferees and payroll.

entity_title: CCSS enrollment is a condition of residency
fact_text: Holding CCSS ('la Caja') insurance is a basic requirement of every migratory procedure: residency grants and renewals require enrollment with the Caja Costarricense de Seguro Social. It is a condition of obtaining and keeping residency, not an optional add-on.
evidence_quote: Tal garantía obligará a que todo trámite migratorio deba contemplar, como uno de sus requisitos básicos, contar con los seguros que brinda la Caja Costarricense de Seguro Social (CCSS).

applies_to.non_obvious_note: CCSS enrollment is a hard prerequisite of the residency process itself (Art. 7 of the migration law); a private international policy does not substitute for it.

entity_title: CCSS is mandatory and charged on total pay
fact_text: Coverage by, and enrollment in, the social insurance scheme is compulsory for all salaried workers, and contributions are calculated on the worker's total remuneration under any name. For a corporate hire this is a mandatory, ongoing payroll cost (employer plus employee shares), routinely underestimated by newcomers.
evidence_quote: Las coberturas del Seguro Social -y el ingreso al mismo- son obligatorias para todos los trabajadores manuales e intelectuales que perciban sueldo o salario. El monto de las cuotas que por esta ley se deban pagar, se calculará sobre el total de las remuneraciones que bajo cualquier denominación se paguen, con motivo o derivados de la relación obrero-patronal.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: CCSS is contributory and mandatory on total pay - a recurring employer+employee payroll cost, not a one-off registration (Ley Constitutiva CCSS, Art. 3).

entity_title: Overstaying costs US$100/month or a re-entry ban
fact_text: Any irregular stay triggers a migration fine of US$100 for each month of irregular stay or, failing payment, a re-entry ban equal to three times the period of irregular presence. Gaps between a tourist entry and an approved residency, or a lapsed renewal, carry real penalties.
evidence_quote: Toda estancia irregular en territorio costarricense hará que las personas extranjeras deban cancelar una multa migratoria equivalente a cien dólares moneda de los Estados Unidos de América (US$100,00), por cada mes de estancia irregular en el país o, en su defecto, se les prohibirá el ingreso por un plazo equivalente al triple del tiempo de su permanencia irregular.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Falling out of status (e.g. while residency is pending or a renewal lapses) is penalized at US$100/month or a re-entry ban of triple the overstay (Art. 33(3)) - timing the filing matters.
